audit_conclusions: The retained source corpus has substantial evidence for thirteen recovered base-type families/usages; 683 safe statblock records are attributable to their supporting type collections without counting the mixed Illusion usage.

Eleven type families have recovered usable family semantics, Dragon remains partially normalized, Beast has repeated usage without a dedicated recovered family contract, and Illusion remains an orphan unresolved type usage.

The current 27 canonical Creature Definitions still have zero explicit stable-ID type bindings. Source-label, namespace, mechanics, source collection, or apparent fit cannot be used to manufacture those bindings.
Cross-cutting systems such as Plant, Incorporeal, Zombie, Ghost, transformation systems and Animal biology are not reclassified as missing base types.
The four audited type-coverage gaps are preserved for later governed resolution; CEW-08 performs no new-creature or type-system invention.
